qa.overall_assessment: All 6 acceptance criteria verified. Wire protocol accepts sidechain events, CLI mapper emits sidechain (not text) for sidechain roots, Agent tool gets synthetic sidechain root same as Task, App normalizer produces sidechain content type, App tracer registers CUID2, and end-to-end sidebar visibility confirmed in browser on both desktop (1280x720) and mobile (390x844) viewports. No regressions, no band-aid patterns, no hardcoded values.

root_cause_verification.rationale: All 5 layers of the gap are addressed: (1) wire protocol now has sidechain event schema, (2) CLI mapper emits sidechain instead of text for sidechain roots, (3) CLI launcher creates synthetic roots for both Agent and Task, (4) App normalizer handles sidechain events and produces correct NormalizedMessage, (5) App tracer registers CUID2 for child inheritance. The end-to-end flow was verified in the live browser showing Agent tool card with full subagent conversation.
